NH3 Pig

Lorenzo Benedetti

2026-03-17

1 Data import and preparation

The file Pig ammonia finale.xlsx must be located in the same folder as this R Markdown file and must contain at least the columns TREATMENT, BLOCK, and N-NH3 perc TAN.

data_file <- "Pig ammonia finale.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop(
    "The file 'Pig ammonia finale.xlsx' was not found. ",
    "Save the Excel file in the same folder as the R Markdown file."
  )
}

data <- read_excel(data_file)

required_columns <- c("TREATMENT", "BLOCK", "N-NH3 perc TAN")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(data))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following columns are missing from the Excel file: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

data <- data %>%
  rename(NH3_TN = `N-NH3 perc TAN`) %>%
  mutate(
    TREATMENT = factor(TREATMENT),
    BLOCK = factor(BLOCK)
  )

if (anyNA(data[c("NH3_TN", "TREATMENT", "BLOCK")])) {
  warning(
    "Missing values are present in NH3_TN, TREATMENT, or BLOCK. ",
    "The model will use complete observations only."
  )
}

2 Experimental-design check

The following table shows the number of observations for each block-by-treatment combination. In a randomized complete block design, each cell should contain one observation.

design_table <- with(data, table(BLOCK, TREATMENT, useNA = "ifany"))

kable(
  as.data.frame.matrix(design_table),
  caption = "Number of observations per block and treatment"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Number of observations per block and treatment
PSAA PSH2SO4 PSRAW
1 1 1
1 1 1
1 1 1 
if (any(design_table != 1)) {
  warning(
    "The design does not contain exactly one observation for each ",
    "BLOCK x TREATMENT combination. Check the data file before ",
    "interpreting the model."
  )
}

3 Descriptive statistics

These are unadjusted descriptive statistics. Estimated marginal means from the block model are reported below.

desc <- data %>%
  group_by(TREATMENT) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(NH3_TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(NH3_TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(NH3_TN)),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(
  desc,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Descriptive statistics by treatment"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Descriptive statistics by treatment
TREATMENT mean sd n se
PSAA 2.689 0.735 3 0.424
PSH2SO4 2.564 0.854 3 0.493
PSRAW 4.485 1.580 3 0.912

4 Statistical model

Cumulative ammonia emissions are analysed using the following model:

\[ Y_{ij} = \mu + \tau_i + \beta_j + \varepsilon_{ij}, \]

where \(\tau_i\) represents the fixed effect of treatment, \(\beta_j\) represents the fixed effect of block, and \(\varepsilon_{ij}\) is the residual error, assumed to be independent and normally distributed with a mean of zero and constant variance. The block-by-treatment interaction is not included because there is only one observation for each combination.

model <- lm(NH3_TN ~ BLOCK + TREATMENT, data = data)

coefficient_table <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients)

kable(
  coefficient_table,
  row.names = TRUE,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Coefficients of the linear model including block and treatment"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Coefficients of the linear model including block and treatment
Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>&#124;t&#124;)
(Intercept) 3.3303 0.8275 4.0246 0.0158

BLOCK3 -0.6100 0.9064 -0.6730 0.5378
TREATMENTPSH2SO4 -0.1248 0.9064 -0.1376 0.8972
TREATMENTPSRAW 1.7962 0.9064 1.9815 0.1186

4.1 Analysis of variance

Type II tests are reported; each effect is therefore evaluated after accounting for the other effect included in the model.

anova_res <- car::Anova(model, type = 2)

kable(
  as.data.frame(anova_res),
  row.names = TRUE,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Type II ANOVA for the randomized block model"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Type II ANOVA for the randomized block model
Sum Sq Df F value Pr(>F)
BLOCK 2.5994 2 1.0546 0.4287
TREATMENT 6.9317 2 2.8121 0.1727
Residuals 4.9299 4 NA NA 
model_information <- data.frame(
  observations = nobs(model),
  residual_df = df.residual(model),
  residual_sd = sigma(model),
  R_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
  adjusted_R_squared = summary(model)$adj.r.squared
)

kable(
  model_information,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Model information"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Model information
observations residual_df residual_sd R_squared adjusted_R_squared

5 Estimated marginal means

Estimated marginal means are adjusted for the block effect. Confidence intervals are calculated at the 95% level.

emm <- emmeans(model, ~ TREATMENT)

emm_results <- summary(
  emm,
  infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  level = 0.95
)

kable(
  as.data.frame(emm_results),
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Block-adjusted estimated marginal means with 95% confidence intervals"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Block-adjusted estimated marginal means with 95% confidence intervals
TREATMENT emmean SE df lower.CL upper.CL
PSAA 2.689 0.641 4 0.909 4.468
PSH2SO4 2.564 0.641 4 0.784 4.343
PSRAW 4.485 0.641 4 2.705 6.264

6 Treatment contrasts

All pairwise comparisons are performed on the estimated marginal means. P values and simultaneous confidence intervals are adjusted using Tukey’s method. The estimated differences, expressed in the original unit of the response, are the primary effect sizes of the analysis.

tukey_contrasts <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")

contrast_results <- summary(
  tukey_contrasts,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  level = 0.95,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

kable(
  as.data.frame(contrast_results),
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Estimated treatment differences with simultaneous 95% confidence intervals",
    "and Tukey-adjusted P values"
  )
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Estimated treatment differences with simultaneous 95% confidence intervals and Tukey-adjusted P values
contrast estimate SE df lower.CL upper.CL t.ratio p.value
PSAA - PSH2SO4 0.125 0.906 4 -3.106 3.355 0.138 0.990
PSAA - PSRAW -1.796 0.906 4 -5.027 1.434 -1.982 0.232
PSH2SO4 - PSRAW -1.921 0.906 4 -5.151 1.310 -2.119 0.201

7 Model diagnostics

With a small number of observations, diagnostic tests have limited power. Numerical results should therefore be interpreted together with the residual plots.

shapiro_res <- shapiro.test(residuals(model))

shapiro_table <- data.frame(
  test = "Shapiro-Wilk test on model residuals",
  statistic = unname(shapiro_res$statistic),
  df = NA,
  p_value = shapiro_res$p.value
)

diagnostic_data <- data.frame(
  residual = residuals(model),
  treatment = model.frame(model)$TREATMENT
)

levene_res <- car::leveneTest(
  residual ~ treatment,
  data = diagnostic_data,
  center = median
)

kable(
  shapiro_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Residual normality test"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
Residual normality test
test statistic df p_value
Shapiro-Wilk test on model residuals 0.9425 NA 0.6085 
kable(
  as.data.frame(levene_res),
  row.names = TRUE,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Levene's test applied to the model residuals"
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

8 Data representation by block

Lines connect observations belonging to the same block, thereby showing the matched structure of the experimental design.

ggplot(
  data,
  aes(
    x = TREATMENT,
    y = NH3_TN,
    group = BLOCK,
    colour = BLOCK
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "N-NH3 (% of TN)",
    colour = "Block",
    title = "N-NH3 percentage of total N by block"
  )

Observed treatment values distinguished by block

9 Estimated marginal means and confidence intervals

emm_plot_data <- as.data.frame(emm_results)

ggplot(
  emm_plot_data,
  aes(x = TREATMENT, y = emmean)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Estimated marginal mean of N-NH3 (% of TN)",
    title = "Block-adjusted treatment means with 95% confidence intervals"
  )

Block-adjusted estimated marginal means and 95% confidence intervals
